text: Noema（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在每轮编码任务前后比较工作区代码，帮助开发者定位复杂度变化较大的文件和函数。它监听会话轮次，分析 TypeScript、TSX、Python 与 Go，并在聊天回合下方展示圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度的变化。用户可在插件设置中配置文件包含与排除模式。适合希望把代码审查重点放在结构变化上的 DSH 开发者；分析在本地运行，无需额外服务。

Noema is a DSH Web plugin that compares code before and after each coding turn. It analyzes TypeScript, TSX, Python, and Go, showing changes in complexity and nesting below the chat turn. Configure included files in plugin settings. Analysis runs locally.
想在每次 AI 编码后看看哪些函数变复杂了。
帮我比较一轮 DSH 会话前后的代码复杂度。
我想知道这次改动增加了多少嵌套和分支。
让聊天界面标出值得重点审查的文件和函数。
能按工作区文件模式限制复杂度分析范围吗？
查看 TypeScript、Python 或 Go 代码的复杂度变化。
Show me which functions became more complex after an AI coding turn.
Compare code complexity before and after each DSH turn.
Highlight changed files and functions with nesting and complexity metrics.
Let me exclude test files from local complexity analysis.
Noema 的功能「编码回合复杂度对比」：每轮开始和结束时捕获工作区快照，并比较支持语言文件的变化。分析针对变动文件计算复杂度差异，结果显示在对应聊天回合下方。
Noema 的功能「函数复杂度指标」：解析 TypeScript、TSX、Python 和 Go 代码，按模块、函数和顶层范围统计圈复杂度、认知复杂度及最大嵌套深度。
Noema 的功能「文件范围设置」：用户可在 Web 插件设置中编辑 include 与 exclude glob 模式；排除规则用于跳过不希望纳入快照分析的文件。
Noema 的功能「聊天报告卡片」：在聊天回合尾部显示报告，按文件和函数呈现复杂度指标及变化，支持展开定位层级范围。
Noema 的功能「本地工作区快照」：按配置扫描工作区源文件，尊重 .gitignore，并限制单文件、总快照大小和文件数量。

Keep your standards in AI-assisted development

Noema is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin for developers who care about the code they ship. After each coding task, it shows complexity changes to help you decide which files and functions need a closer look

dsh-plugin-noema README · Review changes：Noema compares three metrics before and after each task:

| Metric | What it measures |
| --- | --- |
| Cyclomatic complexity | Independent paths through the code |
| Cognitive complexity | Difficulty of following control flow, accounting for branches, nesting, and recursion |
| Maximum nesting depth | Deepest nesting of control structures within a function |

dsh-plugin-noema README · Review changes：Expand a file or function to locate changes within it. Its metrics include the code it contains; `[Top Level]` shows its own code separately from named child functions. Unchanged code is hidden by default and can be revealed when needed

These metrics help focus your review. Judge changes in the context of the code: a lower score alone does not mean better code

dsh-plugin-noema README · Review changes：Analysis runs locally and compares the workspace at the start and end of each turn, including any manual edits made during that time. Results stay outside the model context

dsh-plugin-noema README · Supported languages：TypeScript (including TSX), Python, and Go are supported. JavaScript and TypeScript declaration files are excluded

No card appears when there are no supported code changes, including edits limited to comments or formatting. Code changes still appear when the scores remain the same

dsh-plugin-noema README · Install：Supports DSH `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-alpha.1` and requires Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`

Install the npm package into the Web profile, then start DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-noema
dsh web
```

If DSH is already running, restart it and refresh the browser. Noema starts analyzing new turns after installation; ask DSH to modify a supported source file to try it

dsh-plugin-noema README · Choose files：Open **Plugins → Noema → Files to analyze** in the Web sidebar. Set include and exclude patterns relative to your workspace, such as `src/**` and `**/*.test.ts`, or use **Add common test exclusions**. Settings apply to the current Profile. Exclusions take precedence, and saved changes apply from the next turn

Noema respects `.gitignore` and excludes common dependency and build directories by default
